lines.text: Twelve persimmons, peeled and hung to dry.
lines.sub:
Twelve persimmons,
peeled and hung to dry.

lines.text: No fire, no oven. Just cold air, and weeks of waiting.
lines.sub:
No fire, no oven.
Just cold air, and weeks of waiting.

lines.text: Day by day, they darken, and soften.
lines.sub: Day by day, they darken, and soften.

lines.text: Then one morning, a magpie took one.
lines.sub: Then one morning, a magpie took one.

lines.text: Here, people leave the last few persimmons on the tree for the birds.
lines.sub:
Here, people leave the last few persimmons
on the tree for the birds.

lines.text: By the first snow, the rest had turned sweet.
lines.sub:
By the first snow,
the rest had turned sweet.
